verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so dedicated GPU deployments with autoscaling are a fair question for it. The evidence shows only shared API access, per-model service tiers, regional hosting, and a vague option to send requests 'to your own cloud'. None of these documents dedicated GPU capacity, isolation from a shared pool, or autoscaling.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool
